Introduction
This document outlines the steps of maintenance procedure I1, carried out annually Y1, or in case of a fault in the instrument, whichever comes first, on the mercury-type turbine exhaust pressure measuring instrument located at zero level next to the condensate pump.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Hassanein Mohamed at Assiut Steam Power Station, tested by Eng. Mohamed Abdel Mohsen Mohamed, reviewed by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras, General Manager, accepted by Eng. Hassan Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of Assiut Steam Station Sector, and approved by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the station Operations Department, signed by the instrument maintenance technicians assigned to carry out the maintenance work, under the supervision of the maintenance engineer executing the work order approved by the Head of the Instrument Maintenance Department.
Record the industrial safety category of all personnel working on the work order.
Isolate the exhaust pressure measuring instrument by closing the isolation valve above the instrument, to ensure the unit vacuum does not drop during the work order.
Monitor the unit vacuum during the execution of the work order using the vacuum measuring instrument in the unit's thermal room.
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Insulating plastic gloves
Small box filled with mercury
Empty container to discharge the mercury into
Open-end wrench sizes 24 and 27, large flat screwdriver
Procedures to be Carried Out
Open the work order. | 1.
Isolate the vacuum measuring instrument by closing the isolation valve plug. | 2.
Remove the instrument from the work site and bring it to the instrument maintenance workshop. | 3.
Discharge the mercury into the container designated for it. | 4.
Inspect the glass connection to make sure there is no leakage in it. | 5.
Fill the glass connection in a U-shape up to zero level from both sides of the connection. | 6.
Return the equipment to service
Reinstall the instrument in its place. | 1.
Open the isolation valve plug. | 2.
Make sure the vacuum pressure equals the pressure in the thermal room. | 3.
Close the work order. | 4.
